flow_name: B2B Customer Self-Registration (UAE Pass + TL OCR + Face ID + 3-Way Branching)

automation_boundary.automated_scope: Login page -> Click REGISTER -> Requirements screen -> UAE Pass login & push -> Interstitial EID retrieval -> Customer details (Email, Mobile) -> Dual OTP verification -> Select Emirate -> Upload Trade License (PDF/PNG/JPG <= 5MB) -> Validate/Edit OCR metadata modal -> Save details -> Face ID consent -> Camera capture ('I'M READY') -> 3-way authorization branch (Owner / POA / Delegate LOA).
automation_boundary.external_boundary: UAE Pass IdP token exchange, camera video feed mocking, and OCR backend processing are external services. Automation harnesses supply pre-configured mock files and bypass live camera capture via Playwright browser context permissions.

canonical_steps.action: Navigate to B2B Portal login page and click REGISTER
canonical_steps.expected_result: The 'What's Needed' and 'Register Online' screen is displayed

canonical_steps.action: Click 'Sign In with UAE PASS' to initiate identity verification
canonical_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to the UAE PASS authentication screen

canonical_steps.action: Enter Emirates ID or registered identifier and submit UAE Pass login
canonical_steps.target: //input[@placeholder='Emirates ID or email address or UAE mobile number']
canonical_steps.expected_result: Push challenge number is presented to confirm in the UAE PASS mobile app

canonical_steps.action: Confirm mobile push and observe 'Fetching Emirates ID from UAE PASS' interstitial
canonical_steps.target: //button[contains(.,'CONTINUE WITH UAE PASS')] | //div[contains(.,'fetching your Emirates ID')]
canonical_steps.expected_result: Emirates ID data is retrieved and the Customer Details form appears

canonical_steps.action: Enter the customer personal email address
Enter the customer UAE mobile phone number
Click PROCEED to trigger Dual OTP verification
canonical_steps.expected_result: The 'VERIFY YOUR DETAILS' screen is displayed showing dual OTP entry sections

canonical_steps.action: Enter the 6-digit mobile OTP and 6-digit email OTP and click CONTINUE
canonical_steps.expected_result: Dual OTP verification succeeds and the 'Select the Emirate where your Trade License is registered' screen is displayed

canonical_steps.action: Select the Emirate where the Trade License was issued and click CONTINUE
canonical_steps.expected_result: The 'Upload your Trade License' dropzone screen appears

canonical_steps.action: Upload the Trade License document (JPEG, PNG, or PDF <= 5MB)
canonical_steps.expected_result: The file uploads, system triggers OCR check, and opens the Trade License Details modal

canonical_steps.action: Verify auto-populated metadata in Trade License Details modal and click SAVE
canonical_steps.expected_result: Trade License details are saved and the file card shows '100% Complete'

canonical_steps.action: Click PROCEED to navigate to Face ID Authentication
canonical_steps.expected_result: The Face ID instructions and consent checklist screen appears

canonical_steps.action: Click PROCEED TO AUTHENTICATION and then click I'M READY to capture photo
canonical_steps.target: //button[contains(.,'I\'M READY') or contains(.,'I\'m Ready') or contains(.,'Im Ready')]
canonical_steps.expected_result: Biometric face frame activates, validates face, and displays 'Face Captured! ✓'

canonical_steps.action: Verify the 3-way authorization options screen is presented
canonical_steps.target: //div[contains(.,'Continue registration using one of the options below')]
canonical_steps.expected_result: Three options are displayed: (1) Owner/Company Manager, (2) Power of Attorney, (3) Digital LOA

canonical_steps.action: Click CONTINUE under Owner/Company Manager to finalize registration
canonical_steps.expected_result: Registration completes successfully and user account is created
